title: workspace-checkpoints' 15s waitFor default is the same quiet-host bound
body:
The kjs-covered file still waits on wall-clock conditions with a 15s default while its two full-Harness tests now carry 120s vitest bounds. Under the same load that starved local-host (load average 23-47), an inner 15s waitFor would throw first and fail the test on the host, not the tree - the same class 7wg just fixed one file over. Not observed failing (the pair passed at load ~40 tonight), so low; worth a tick only if it ever bites.
evidence: harness/test/node/workspace-checkpoints.test.ts:128 (waitFor default 15_000)
